title: Basic Bedding
text: Basic Bedding. This comforter set is basic bedding. It's nothing fancy. It's a black comforter that reverses to white. The fabric is not very soft. With that being said it's not scratchy either. It fits the bed as expected. It serves its purpose.

product_metadata.title: KeoWin Full/Queen Blue 3-Piece Comforter Set Alternative Quilted Bed-in-a-Bag, Reversible, Ultra Soft, Lightweight, Cooling, Breathable for Men & Women in Bedroom
features: 🛏️【3 Piece Queen Comforter Set】Includes 1 Comforter (86" x 86"), and 2 Pillow Shams (20" x 26"+2"). One side is black and the other side is light ivory, which can be flipped according to your room decor, sheets, and mood.

✨【Perfect Colorful Home Decoration】We currently have four sets of pretty colors and two sets of exquisite patterns, which are beautifully matched to your room decor, and the comforter set will bring an elegant look to your bedding and provide more choices for home decoration.

☀️【Easy Care (Gentle Cycle)】: Simply machine washes this comforter in cold water (under 30℃/86℉) separately in the gentle cycle. Since the products are vacuum packaged, it is highly recommended to hang out the comforter set in the sun and gently tap it for increased fluffiness.

🧵【Lightweight BUT Warm】Based on the lightweight, perfect cooling comforter with the super smooth double brushed microfiber that makes it great for sleep or a nap. The plush polyester filling makes it warm enough on cold nights for great use during Spring, Summer & Autumn.

🎁【Great Gift Choice】Give your bedroom a style update with this beautiful comforter set that also has a matching pillow sham for a relaxing cozy night's sleep or a daytime nap. This comforter set can be an enchanting and valuable ideal gift to your family or friends on Birthdays, Housewarming, or Back to School.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Sun-dried, Lightly patted, Hand Wash Only
